title: Theme Customization
description: Learn how to customize your store theme, including colors, fonts, layouts, and advanced customization options.
content:
Theme Customization

Customize your store theme to match your brand identity and create a unique shopping experience for your customers.

Accessing Theme Customization

Navigate to Store Settings → Theme Customization to access all customization options.

Color Customization

Customize your theme colors:

  • Primary Color: Main brand color
  • Secondary Color: Accent color
  • Text Colors: Heading and body text
  • Background Colors: Page and section backgrounds
  • Button Colors: Call-to-action buttons
  • Link Colors: Hyperlink colors

Typography

Customize fonts and typography:

  • Heading Font: Font for headings
  • Body Font: Font for body text
  • Font Sizes: Adjust heading and body sizes
  • Line Height: Spacing between lines
  • Letter Spacing: Character spacing

Layout Options

Configure layout settings:

  • Container Width: Content width
  • Sidebar Position: Left, right, or none
  • Product Grid: Columns per row
  • Product Page Layout: Image and details layout

Header Customization

Customize the header:

  • Header style (sticky, transparent)
  • Logo placement and size
  • Navigation menu style
  • Search bar options
  • Cart icon style
  • User account links

Footer Customization

Customize the footer:

  • Footer columns layout
  • Footer content
  • Social media links
  • Newsletter signup
  • Copyright information
  • Footer menu

Homepage Sections

Customize homepage sections:

  • Hero/banner section
  • Featured products
  • Categories showcase
  • Testimonials
  • Latest blog posts
  • Newsletter signup
  • Custom sections

Product Page Customization

Customize product pages:

  • Image gallery layout
  • Product information layout
  • Related products section
  • Reviews section
  • Add to cart button style

Advanced Customization

For advanced users:

  • Custom CSS
  • Template modifications
  • JavaScript customization
  • Widget areas

Preview Changes

Always preview changes before publishing:

  • Use preview mode
  • Test on different devices
  • Check all pages
  • Verify functionality

Saving Customizations

Save your customizations:

  • Click "Save Changes"
  • Changes apply immediately
  • Can revert to default
  • Export customization settings

Best Practices

  • Maintain brand consistency
  • Use high contrast for readability
  • Keep customization minimal
  • Test on all devices
  • Ensure fast loading times
  • Follow accessibility guidelines
